putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.

row.answer: Bard is a support mage who combines magic-damage attacks with conditional stuns and portals through terrain. His damage benefits from AP, while his ultimate puts allies and enemies into stasis.
row.counterplay: Avoid lining up with terrain or other enemies, and approach his portals cautiously.
